input.procedure: Decode source with scripts/tes4_runtime_state.py; require empty ledger next2 and no controller. No attack/contact/reaction/damage outcome is injected. Imported generic defaults may normalize; assertions start from the actual baseline save.

fixture.reuse: Existing stationary opponent, equipped-block input map, recovery look bindings, SDL replay and epoch/save monitor. Only a read-only Player geometry observer is added; no new harness.

protocol.movement: HoldD until observedx>=760, then holdS until observedy<=-125. Release inputs and aim at the target with normal mouse motion. Displacement is observed rather than timed.
protocol.mouse: Prime two zero-delta events for warp compensation and first-move suppression before relative look-100. The actual saved yaw changes to-0.390625.
protocol.range: In this stock-shortsword/normal-scale course, require distance>200 scene units, facing<10degrees and clear world/door rays100/125 above both roots, then a native miss. This threshold is specific to this course, not a generic reach formula.
protocol.endpoint: Wait for miss4 to finish and process action-1 before the final save.
protocol.fps: Configured cap15; measured FPS acceptance matrix remains open.
